title: Project chat
responsibility: Keeps project chat available on every screen and links discussed or changed units to their commit history.

inputs.name: ProjectAgent.workspace
inputs.description: The selected project, revision, permissions, bridge and navigation. Conversation state stays with this project as its screens change.

outputs.name: ProjectAgent
outputs.description: A persistent round chat bubble and conversation panel. Read users browse; Comment users leave comments; Write users can choose a model and ask, plan or change at a writable branch tip. Registered unit references open their history.

examples.expected: Existing open-panel catalog identity and screenshot remain unchanged.

examples.title: Closed launcher
examples.expected: Panel hidden; one accessible launcher remains. Open, close and Escape preserve the conversation and draft; focus returns safely.

examples.title: Read-only conversation
examples.expected: Read permission can browse messages and references; no comment or agent submission is available.

examples.title: Pending local comment
examples.expected: Disconnected comment-capable context explains local pending drafts. Blank text cannot submit; typed comment is human-only.

examples.title: Connected human comment
examples.expected: Connected comment-only context saves a trimmed human comment without launching an agent and clears it on success.

examples.title: Failed comment preserves draft
examples.expected: A synthetic comment-save refusal is visible and preserves entered text for retry; no agent launches.

examples.title: Conversation and references
examples.expected: Human and assistant messages, long wrapped text, known unit history links and unknown/plain references render safely.

examples.title: Historical revision
examples.expected: Pinned or historical selection keeps its revision on links and blocks write-mode agent requests.

examples.title: Ask request
examples.expected: Writable agent-capable context selects Ask with discovered model and effort; trimmed request has the exact chosen identity.

examples.title: Plan request
examples.expected: Writable nonvisual context selects Plan; requires a provider/model and sends a plan request.

examples.title: Visual Plan request
examples.expected: Visual context uses the saved valid design-option count for Plan; mode controls remain compact and usable.

examples.title: Change request
examples.expected: Writable authorized context selects Change and submits only with its prerequisites; no real agent/provider is contacted.

examples.title: No available agent model
examples.expected: Agent-capable context without a usable provider/model cannot submit an agent request; comments remain usable if allowed.

examples.title: Agent running
examples.expected: Matching synthetic public progress is visible while message entry and duplicate submission are disabled; terminal completion unlocks it.

examples.title: Saved plan retained
examples.expected: A completed plan retains its public saved-plan response and associated registered-unit references in the conversation.

examples.title: Agent failure
examples.expected: Synthetic terminal failure is visible in the owning conversation and leaves the composer usable for a deliberate retry.

examples.title: Agents tracked and empty
examples.expected: Agents tab distinguishes a successful empty roster from unknown tracking and preserves the Chat draft on return.

examples.title: Active agents and ownership
examples.expected: Agents tab shows current sessions, tasks and module assignments with resolved module history links.

examples.title: Unknown agent tracking
examples.expected: Unavailable or unsupported activity tracking is explicitly unknown; it does not claim an empty or current roster.

examples.title: Stale agent tracking
examples.expected: Stale activity data is visibly stale and carries no current module ownership claim.

examples.title: Long agents roster
examples.expected: A deterministic long roster scrolls within the component while task and module labels remain readable and navigation stays usable.
